## Functions

### `ListGroup`

```ts
ListGroup(props: ListGroupProps): Html
```

A vertical list of rows — links, buttons or plain text — with an
active row, disabled rows, icons, badges and trailing meta. A real
`<ul>` (or `<ol>` when `numbered`), so it needs no script.

## Types

### `ListGroupVariant`

`flush` drops the outer border and radius — for a list inside a card.

- `"default"`
- `"flush"`

### `ListGroupSize`

- `"sm"`
- `"md"`

### `ListGroupItem`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string | Html` | yes |  |
| `text` | `string | Html` |  | A second, muted line under the label. |
| `href` | `string` |  | Makes the row a link. |
| `action` | `boolean` |  | Makes the row a `<button type="button">` (give it `attrs`); ignored with `href`. |
| `active` | `boolean` |  | The current row: accent bar and sunken ground, `aria-current="true"`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Muted and inert (`aria-disabled`; a link loses its href). |
| `icon` | `Html` |  | Leading icon. |
| `badge` | `Html` |  | Trailing badge (a `Badge`, a count). |
| `meta` | `string | Html` |  | Small muted text at the end of the row — a time, a size. |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  | Extra attributes on the row's link/button (or the `<li>` for a plain row). |

### `ListGroupProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` |  |  |
| `items` | `ListGroupItem[]` | yes |  |
| `variant` | `ListGroupVariant` |  |  |
| `numbered` | `boolean` |  | Renders an `<ol>` with a counter in front of each row. |
| `size` | `ListGroupSize` |  |  |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### A folder list with counts

Links fill their rows; the current one carries `aria-current` and the accent bar.

```ts
ListGroup({
  id: "folders",
  items: [
    {
      label: "Inbox",
      href: "/mail/inbox",
      icon: Icon("mail", { size: 16 }),
      badge: Badge({ label: "12", variant: "accent" }),
      active: true,
    },
    { label: "Sent", href: "/mail/sent", icon: Icon("send", { size: 16 }) },
    { label: "Archive", href: "/mail/archive", icon: Icon("folder", { size: 16 }), meta: "1.2 GB" },
  ],
})
```

```html
<ul class="list-group" id="folders" role="list">
  <li>
    <a class="list-group__item list-group__item--active" aria-current="true" href="/mail/inbox">
      <span class="list-group__icon" aria-hidden="true">
        <svg width="16" height="16" width="2" width="18" height="14" …>…</svg>
      </span>
      <span class="list-group__body">
        <span class="list-group__label">Inbox</span>
      </span>
      <span class="list-group__badge">
        <span class="badge badge--accent">12</span>
      </span>
    </a>
  </li>
  <li>
    <a class="list-group__item" href="/mail/sent">
      <span class="list-group__icon" aria-hidden="true">
        <svg width="16" height="16" width="2" …>…</svg>
      </span>
      <span class="list-group__body">
        <span class="list-group__label">Sent</span>
      </span>
    </a>
  </li>
  <li>
    <a class="list-group__item" href="/mail/archive">
      <span class="list-group__icon" aria-hidden="true">
        <svg width="16" height="16" width="2" …>…</svg>
      </span>
      <span class="list-group__body">
        <span class="list-group__label">Archive</span>
      </span>
      <span class="list-group__meta">1.2 GB</span>
    </a>
  </li>
</ul>
```

### Numbered steps inside a card

`flush` drops the frame so the card's own border does the work.

```ts
ListGroup({
  id: "setup-steps",
  variant: "flush",
  numbered: true,
  items: [
    { label: "Connect a repository", text: "GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket." },
    { label: "Pick a plan", text: "Free while you evaluate.", active: true },
    { label: "Invite your team", text: "Up to five seats on the free plan.", disabled: true },
  ],
})
```

```html
<ol class="list-group list-group--flush list-group--numbered" id="setup-steps" role="list">
  <li class="list-group__item">
    <span class="list-group__body">
      <span class="list-group__label">Connect a repository</span>
      <span class="list-group__text">GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket.</span>
    </span>
  </li>
  <li class="list-group__item list-group__item--active" aria-current="true">
    <span class="list-group__body">
      <span class="list-group__label">Pick a plan</span>
      <span class="list-group__text">Free while you evaluate.</span>
    </span>
  </li>
  <li class="list-group__item list-group__item--disabled" aria-disabled="true">
    <span class="list-group__body">
      <span class="list-group__label">Invite your team</span>
      <span class="list-group__text">Up to five seats on the free plan.</span>
    </span>
  </li>
</ol>
```
